title: Diff-Instruct: A Universal Approach for Transferring Knowledge From Pre-trained Diffusion Models

summary.en: Transfers knowledge from pretrained diffusion models to differentiable generators without training data. Integral KL divergence compares distributions along a diffusion process, providing a shared framework for one-step diffusion distillation and the refinement of existing GAN generators.
summary.zh: 在无需原始训练数据的条件下，将预训练扩散模型的知识迁移到可微生成器。方法沿扩散过程积分 KL 散度，以统一的分布匹配框架支持单步生成器蒸馏，以及对已有 GAN 生成器的改进。
